messages:
Hana Ito: Opening a compact PR that bundles rate-limit header docs, a short quota-tier example, and the Console panel ID update. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/823
Marcus Lee: Please include a tiny section that clarifies per-route caps vs account-level quotas. One-line table or bullet list is fine. Customers confuse the two.
Hana Ito: Draft wording: 'Per-route cap: limit applied to a single API route (e.g., /v2/generate). Account quota: pooled token allowance across routes. When a per-route cap is hit, you'll get 429 + `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0` for that route but other routes may still succeed.'
Vera Novak: For the Console note, grafana panel ID changed from 45 -> 61. Add both links and mark the old link as deprecated in text. I uploaded new PNGs: assets/console/token_consumption_v3.png
Ian Cho: Snippets: include a 3-line Go example that reads `X-Burst-Credits` and falls back to cheaper model when credits < 10. Keep tiny. Also add a curl example showing raw headers.
Hana Ito: Go snippet:
```go
// minimal: check burst credits
hdr := resp.Header.Get("X-Burst-Credits")
credits, _ := strconv.Atoi(hdr)
if credits < 10 {
  useModel("gpt-economy")
}
```
Marcus Lee: Add a short pricing macro: cost_per_1k = $0.0025; show formula: cost = tokens/1000 * cost_per_1k; include a one-line Python example to compute and round to 4 decimals.
Hana Ito: Python snippet:
```python
tokens = 780
cost_per_1k = 0.0025
cost = tokens/1000 * cost_per_1k
print(f"Estimated: ${cost:.4f}")
```
Vera Novak: L10n: please keep the old panel label in parentheses for three weeks, and add a TODO comment with removal date. I'll file an i18n ticket after merge.
Ian Cho: Ops note: older Dedicated telemetry proxies might expose `x-old-burst` and `x-old-quota`. Add a one-line migration table mapping old -> new header names.
Hana Ito: Added migration table (brief) and a troubleshooting bullet: 'If headers missing, compute cost client-side using published model rates and log a warning.'
DocsBot: PR 823 opened by Hana Ito — CI: docs-build (staging) passed ✅ — Preview: https://deploy-preview-823--docs.redwood.ai
Marcus Lee: QA checklist on the PR: update screenshots, verify Grafana link, validate header names with eng-runtime, add changelog line `docs: clarify rate limits & quotas, add snippets`, and tag i18n.
Hana Ito: Thanks all. Targeting merge Thu AM. Will announce in #announcements and paste the changelog blurb. :sparkles:
